# Original application compatibility fixtures

`gay-lussac-v1.json`, `gay-lussac-v2.json`, `gay-lussac-raw.csv`,
`gay-lussac-analysis.csv`, and `gay-lussac-expected.json` were generated by
executing `gay-lussac/analysis/workspace.js` and `gay-lussac/data/files.js`
from [Cho-WH/bme280 at 59c5c149450f970bace2deaa183857c275595853](https://github.com/Cho-WH/bme280/tree/59c5c149450f970bace2deaa183857c275595853).
The v1 wrapper uses that application's documented uncompressed v1 format;
the v2 and CSV contents come directly from its exporters.

The fixed experiment uses six samples (`temperatureC = i`,
`pressureHpa = 1000 + 3i`, at `1700000000000 + 1000i`), a placement event,
Kelvin and pressure/temperature calculations, a 0–3 second range, excluded
sample 2, enabled regression and an extended graph. Evidence is captured
before applying a table filter and checking sample 3. Answers contain HTML
text and a newline. `expected.json` contains the original validated snapshot,
graph, reflection model, and visible table rows. These distinguish analysis
scope from table filtering and protect raw numeric precision and frozen evidence.

`dashboard-default.csv` was generated with `js/utils/csv.js` from the existing
MicrobitSensorDashboard checkout and the default x/y/z/strength columns. It
contains zero, negative values and a backwards timestamp.

No hardware readings, accuracy certification, or new measurements are claimed
by these deterministic fixtures.
